title: Calif. King Bed Sheet Set
text:
Calif. King Bed Sheet Set. I have a Calif. King mattress. First I want to say the material is nice. BUT and I repeat BUT I think the set was made for a Calif. King and 1/2 more. Yes it's that big. The pillow cases are not finished off. I have king size pillows and, again, I think they each one would almost fit 2 pillows. I don't really know what to make of the whole situation. I'll keep the set but not a happy camper!! I will have to get out the sewing and try to finish the pillow cases. The top sheet will just have to almost hit the floor on both sides of the bed. Again, yep they are that BIG!
What is one to do??

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Queen Bed Sheets Set - 4 Piece Bedding - Brushed Microfiber - Shrinkage and Fade Resistant - Easy Care (Queen, Grey)
features: BED SHEET SET - Queen size 4-piece bed sheets set comprising of 1 flat sheet measuring 90 by 102 inches with a 2 inches self-hem, 1 fitted sheet measuring 60 by 80 inches with a 15 inches box and 2 pillowcases measuring 20 by 30 inches each with a 4 inches hem
ALL-AROUND ELASTIC - The all-around elastic used in the fitted sheet makes it fit easily onto the mattress while giving a nice finish to the bed
BRUSHED MICROFIBER POLYESTER- Brushed microfiber polyester fabric makes the sheet set exceptionally soft
SMOOTH AND COMFORTABLE - The smooth feel of the sheet is very cozy which keeps you cool during summers and warm during winters
SHRINK AND FADE RESISTANT - The microfiber material is processed to make it resistant to shrinkage and fading which adds to the longevity of the set by keeping it in great condition
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - Machine wash, tumble dry or iron on low temperature; do not bleach
